integrity: All finite enumerations are independently rerunnable from embedded C11 source; all 2^25 and 2^26 continuant words are enumerated.
scientific_limitations: Exact low-degree classification conditional on Blackburn's binary orthogonal-multiplicity theorem. The 1998 full text was inaccessible; comparison relies on its reported degree-21 table and on the accessible 2026 work. An independent audit has not been performed.
title: The first degree of orthogonal multiplicity 128 over the binary polynomial ring
